about_the_game:
In the Dreamless Kingdom, no one dreams for themselves. Every night, dreams are extracted and replaced with lifeless replicas—beautiful but hollow. You play as a quiet traveler who begins to collect these forgotten dreams, restoring fragments of wonder to a world on the brink of emotional collapse.

Dreamless Kingdom is a narrative-driven exploration game blending light puzzle-solving, atmospheric storytelling, and surreal world-building. As you traverse dream-warped biomes, you’ll encounter strange villagers, unlock their suppressed hopes, and stitch together the fractured emotional tapestry of a once-vibrant world.

 Key Features

Collect Lost Dreams: Recover scattered dreams and return them to their rightful owners to transform their environment and inner world.

  • Story-Rich Puzzles: Solve environmental challenges that are tied to character arcs and world lore.

  • Distinct Biomes: Explore painterly regions, each shaped by a unique emotional state and visual language.

  • A Living Archive: Unlock journal entries, memories, and lore artifacts that reveal the hidden history of the kingdom.

  • Original Soundscape: Experience an evolving soundtrack that responds to your progress through dreams and regions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8,192 MB (8 GB) MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5,000 MB (5 GB) MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card
  • VR Support: Leave blank unless you support VR
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard, or controller supported

short_description: A narrative-driven exploration game where you collect dreams, restore wonder to a fractured world, and uncover the forgotten desires of its people through puzzles, story fragments, and surreal encounters.
